finding.claim: validateRealm only checks IP-literal realm hosts and only the initial realm URL; hostnames (e.g. localhost or DNS names resolving to private addresses) and redirects from an allowed realm to private/loopback/metadata addresses bypass the check, enabling SSRF from the realm GET and exfiltration of an internal JSON token into the Bearer header sent to the attacker registry.
finding.sink: fetchDistributionToken GET via c.send (client.go:417-434, redirects followed at :136-159); returned token used as Authorization: Bearer (client.go:368-369)
